verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented replication across nodes or zones for high availability, and no documented consistency model for such replication. Storing state in object storage relies on host-platform durability. Server-side namespace copies across regions are one-off backup operations, not ongoing HA replication. The statement that writes appear immediately describes indexing visibility, not replica consistency. None of these earn credit.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can replicate data across nodes or zones for high availability with a documented consistency model
